title: So worth waking up warly on a Sunday for! #BroadwayForever #BroadwayC...
transcript: This morning I attended the Broadway Forever concert in the Bronx, which is a free concert series that is put on by New York Forever and New York Cares. Event was co hosted by Leslie Elm Jr. And Eric Bergen and featured performances from several Broadway shows like Here Lies Love, Shocked, and the upcoming harmony, as well as performances from some Broadway stars like Shoshana Bean and Adam Pascal. I always love events like this cause not only do you get to hear from some Broadway's biggest names like Alex Newell and Shoshana Bean, but you also get to hear from some understudies who you may not have gotten a chance to see before. So it was cool to get to see JD from Here Lies Love and her version of Imelda as well as Veronica from an Juliette and her version of Juliette. They also handed out free ice cream free t shirts. It was definitely worth waking up early on a Sunday morning for. But for me the highlight of the concert was getting to hear Adam Pascal sing a song from rent. Rent is one of my all time favorite shows, and getting to hear him perform one of the songs from the role that he originated over 20 years ago, that was really, really special. I also got to meet Adam Pascal after the concert and got a selfie with him and was totally geeking out. The event was also in partnership with New York Cares, which is An organization that helps you find volunteer opportunities within your local communities actually hosted a park cleanup before the concert, and I believe they had other volunteer opportunities after the concert as well. Definitely recommend keeping your eye out for the next time that they do a concert like this, and checking out the New Yorkers website and seeing what volunteer opportunities they may have in your area.
